homePeople.title: Built around the people running your clinic
homePeople.subtitle: Every delay lands on someone: a front desk answering the same question, a provider running behind, a patient wondering if they were forgotten. clinIQ gives each of them what they need to keep the day moving.

frontDesk.title: Front desk teams
frontDesk.body: Fewer clipboards, fewer repeat questions, and a clear view of who has arrived.
frontDesk.alt: Recepcionista sonriendo mientras un paciente se registra en una tableta en la recepción de la clínica

careTeam.title: Care teams and patients
careTeam.body: Patients know what happens next, and staff can see where every visit stands.
careTeam.alt: Asistente médico con uniforme clínico agachado para hablar con una paciente mayor en la sala de espera de la clínica

provider.title: Providers
provider.body: See the day as it's actually running, not as it was scheduled.
provider.alt: Médica con bata blanca revisando una tableta en un pasillo de la clínica
